items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: Red Mack, Pee Wee Brice, Buster Wilson, and others.

ctx.x: We had a very strong band, all experienced musicians. All had their homes and families here in Los Angeles. The musicians were such as Paul Howard, Lloyd Allen,
Red Mack, Pee Wee Brice, Buster Wilson, and others.
